newsitem.title: UK: Buyers hold back as prices fall on UK meals market.
newsitem.headline: Buyers hold back as prices fall on UK meals market.

text.p: Buyers were holding out for lower prices on the UK meals and feeds market on Wednesday despite reductions of as much as four stg a tonne in soymeal offers.
Lower Chicago prices at the opening on Wednesday gave brokers some hope.
"If Chicago keeps coming down then we could see some business on Thursday," said one.
High protein soymeal fell by two to four stg a tonne ex-mill and stores.
Rapemeal from the Erith mill was unchanged to two stg down while resellers were unchanged to one stg lower.
Prices at the Liverpool and Hull mills were unchanged while corn gluten was one stg lower and sunflower meal and pellets unchanged.
